text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — press briefing with TechCrunch + Verge tomorrow 10am PT. Need final CEO quote + two short social drafts by EOD today. Drafts here: https://redwood.ai/briefing-draft

sam: Who's on the press list? Are we embargoing or live?

olivia: Embargo until 10:05am PT (5 min buffer). Press list: TechCrunch, Verge, The Information, VentureBeat. @raj can you confirm the technical blurb?

raj: Can confirm the perf numbers but request conservative phrasing. Use "up to 3x throughput" not "3x faster". Also clarify GA vs beta where relevant.

maria: Legal note — please remove any "industry-leading" style language. We also need the security whitepaper link before we say "compliant" or similar. I'll paste an approved line below.

olivia: Approved line suggestion from legal:
```"Redwood Inference delivers production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and cost controls."```

mike: Quick CEO quote draft: "Proud of the team's work — this makes advanced inference practical for product teams." Happy to tweak.

sam: Nice. Can you also do a 2-line version for the press release and a 1-line for social?

mike: 2-line: "Proud of the team's work. This makes advanced inference practical for product teams."
1-line: "Making high-performance LLM inference accessible to every engineering team."

olivia: Social drafts (pick one):
```
1) Today we launch Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and cost. Learn more: <link>
2) High-performance LLM serving that scales. Meet Redwood Inference: <link> #mlinfra #llm
```

sam: I'll coordinate the embargo and send the press list + embargo notice after we have final text. Who will host the live briefing?

raj: I can host the tech demo. olivia, can you run the press Q&A?

olivia: Yes. @deploy-bot can you create the calendar event for tomorrow 10am PT and attach the doc?

deploy-bot: Created event "Press briefing — Redwood Inference" for 2025-03-15 10:00 PT. Invitees: olivia, sam, raj, mike, maria.

maria: Timing LGTM. Final legal approval after we replace the placeholder with the security whitepaper link.

olivia: Final ask: drop the approved CEO quote and selected social draft in this thread by 6pm PT so I can schedule the embargo release. Thanks all :pray:

sam: Noted — will take care of embargo email after 6pm and ping reporters once released.
